finding: Current Dashboard publishes public bundle and selector during its DAG node, before EOD completion sealing

evidence.behavior: Calls publish_bundle_pair and publish_selector before writing dashboard/publication.v1.json and returning node outcome
Runs native input DAG first; only after every node is SUCCEEDED calls seal_materialized_completion

implication: A public current Dashboard can precede a valid completed daily DAG if later completion checks fail or the process crashes before EOD seal
next_step: Phase9 concrete plan must move current publication behind authoritative EOD seal while preserving exact historical captures, crash recovery, no backwards publication and consumer proof bindings
